turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I sleep on the sofa because I cannot sleep in our bed without her.
Take your time.
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
Take your time.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
What went through your mind then?
Denise and I got our dog Biscuit eleven years ago, and he follows me from room to room.
Tell me more about that.
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. That is how it was.
Take your time.
Walter from church invited me for a walk, but I made an excuse.
What happened next?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
Take your time.
I had beans on toast three nights in a row, Joy would be shocked.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. I keep coming back to it.
Tell me more about that.
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
Thank you, see you next week.
